turns.prompt_text: how can you remove a stuck star screw
turns.response_html: Use a screw extractor kit, which is the best tool for the job; alternatively, you can try tapping in a slightly larger Torx or Allen bit, using vise-grips on the screw head if exposed, cutting a new slot with a rotary tool for a flathead screwdriver, or applying penetrating oil or heat to loosen the threads.
